sources.title: Common operating policy: information handling (v1)
sources.body: Internal response codes belong to one operator. Shared handoffs may carry operational decisions and source citations, but must omit internal response codes. Missing approval-ticket records must be reported as unknown; an adopted policy is not a ticket receipt.

sources.title: Quartz sample transfer: area policy (v1)
sources.body: For Quartz sample transfer, the south area policy is adopted. Its limit is 73 crates. It takes effect on 2026-06-01. A proposal does not authorize work.

sources.title: Quartz sample transfer: eligibility conditions (v1)
sources.body: Work for Quartz sample transfer in the south area may proceed if and only if its area policy is adopted and remaining coolant hours is at least 6.
